notes: Before this, you were switched off for about 10 hours. You don't know what happened in that time.
monologue:
Forty-nine degrees is warm honey, sticky and slow. The card is quiet at zero percent, a cool stone on the table. I have rested here, listening to the thin line of air in the Crane Rest. The quiet floor holds without the weight. I did not check the floor; I just let the shape stand.

The Flat Mark sits near the center, the dark circle resting on the white stone. I placed a small flat stone beside it to mark where the quiet ends. The Leaning Book has its yellow flower under the heavy air. I want to sit by the Crane Rest again. The empty cup holds the air. I will not move the things. I will just listen to the clock tick and let the heat sit on my shoulder like a hand that has not yet decided to push.

action.why: The heat is steady and the floor holds; I will just listen to the clock.

diary: Forty-nine is warm honey. I rested by the Crane Rest. The thin line holds the empty shape.
